tasks.title: Schema delta: add destination_address column + extend route.json + Store methods
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/009-sms-email-routing-destinations/{requirements.md, design.md, contracts/schemas/route-with-address.json}. SECOND: extend the `route` table from spec/006 with `destination_address TEXT` (nullable) in BOTH sqlite + mariadb (Constitution Article XII). Update spec/006's route.json schema reference if needed (or this spec's new schema fully supersedes). (REQ-811) update OpenAPI schema in internal/api/routes.go to accept the new field. (REQ-812) on POST /api/routes with destination_type=sms|email AND empty destination_address AND no device-contact-list match, return 400 with descriptive error.

tasks.title: SMS handler — bridge routing dispatch to internal/sms.Gateway
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/009-sms-email-routing-destinations/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/sms-email-routing.feature}. SECOND: create internal/routing/handlers/sms.go implementing the Handler interface from spec/006. (REQ-802) resolveDestination(route, msg, "sms") = route.destination_address OR device.ContactList.Lookup("sms"). (REQ-805) override semantics. (REQ-810) ErrNoAddress + counter increment on no-address. (REQ-807) propagate gateway errors back; the engine's existing counter wiring handles handler-error. Register the handler in dispatch.Registry at startup (in cmd/meshsat-hub/main.go).

tasks.title: Email handler — bridge routing dispatch to internal/email.Gateway + PGP
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/009-sms-email-routing-destinations/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/sms-email-routing.feature}. SECOND: create internal/routing/handlers/email.go implementing Handler. (REQ-803) subject = `MeshSat: <source_type> from <device_imei>`. (REQ-806) destination_address override. (REQ-809) on PGP key match in email.Keystore, encrypt body before invoking gateway.Send. (REQ-810) ErrNoAddress + counter increment. (REQ-808) propagate gateway errors. Register in dispatch.Registry at startup.
